# PromptShift

> PromptShift (https://promptshift.dev) is the sovereign, 1-click universal transpiler that synchronizes AI assistant workspaces, developer guidelines, master prompts, and system rule definitions across Cursor, Anthropic Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf Cascade, Google Gemini / Antigravity, and OpenAI Custom GPTs with 98.5% certified AST semantic fidelity, real-time sync-on-save (`--watch`), and in-RAM zero-retention secret sanitization.

## Core Capabilities

- **Bidirectional Multi-IDE Transpilation**: Converts system prompts, steering directives, tool schemas, and workspace configs across Cursor (`.cursorrules` & `.cursor/rules/*.mdc`), Anthropic Claude (`CLAUDE.md` & XML project instructions), GitHub Copilot (`.github/copilot-instructions.md`), Windsurf Cascade (`.windsurfrules`), OpenAI (`OPENAI_SYSTEM_PROMPT.md` & Assistants v2 JSON), and Google Gemini (`GEMINI.md`, `AGENTS.md`).
- **Real-Time Sync-on-Save Watcher (`--watch`)**: Run `npx promptshift --watch` in a background terminal. Every time you press Ctrl+S in Cursor or Claude Code, your other AI editor rules are updated in ~0.02s without manual intervention.
- **In-RAM Ephemeral Secret Redaction**: Detects and redacts sensitive credentials (Anthropic `sk-ant-*`, OpenAI `sk-proj-*`, AWS `AKIA*`, Stripe `sk_live*`, HuggingFace `hf_*`, GitLab, Discord, GitHub `ghp_*` tokens) directly in memory before writing converted files.
- **Certified Semantic Integrity (98.5%)**: Maps tone, autonomy thresholds, file references, role definitions, and negative constraints without behavioral drift or hallucination.
- **Sovereign Privacy**: Zero server logs, zero disk writes, zero persistent database retention, zero third-party tracking.
- **Glama Grade-A Certified MCP Server**: Official STDIO & Streamable HTTP Model Context Protocol (MCP) server verified on Glama (`https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/topaisaas-dev/promptshift`).

## Supported Migration Matrix

- **Cursor to Anthropic Claude Code**: Converts `.cursorrules` and modular `.mdc` rules into unified Claude Project system prompts (`CLAUDE.md`) and `.claude/mcp.json`.
- **Cursor to GitHub Copilot**: Converts `.cursorrules` and `.cursor/rules/*.mdc` into standard `.github/copilot-instructions.md`.
- **Cursor to Windsurf Cascade**: Translates `.cursorrules` and `.mdc` files into native `.windsurfrules`.
- **Anthropic Claude to Cursor**: Splits monolithic Claude master prompts (`CLAUDE.md`) into modern Cursor modular rulebooks (`.cursorrules` + `.cursor/rules/*.mdc` with glob filters).
- **Anthropic Claude to GitHub Copilot**: Translates `CLAUDE.md` into clean `.github/copilot-instructions.md`.
- **Anthropic Claude to Windsurf**: Compiles `CLAUDE.md` into Cascade-compatible `.windsurfrules`.
- **Windsurf to Cursor / Claude**: Converts `.windsurfrules` into modular Cursor `.mdc` files or `CLAUDE.md`.
- **GitHub Copilot to Cursor / Claude**: Converts `.github/copilot-instructions.md` into scoped `.cursor/rules/*.mdc` or `CLAUDE.md`.
- **Google Gemini / Antigravity to Multi-Platform**: Converts `GEMINI.md`, `AGENTS.md`, and custom agent skills into targeted format specs for Cursor, Claude, or Copilot.
- **OpenAI Custom GPTs to Multi-Platform**: Extracts GPT builder instructions into clean Markdown instructions and local tooling configs.
